scope: US, all AI engines, illustrative demo figures
note: Demo data, not measured. Visits are synthetic (cohorts/demo-data.mjs). Prompt volumes are illustrative: the order of the themes follows US prompt research for the same queries (Adobe Brand Visibility, November 2026), the figures are scaled down and varied. Fréscopa is a fictional brand, so who is named is invented. Jobs and experiences are proposals.
wantedNote: Fréscopa has no public filings. These lines are read from its own site copy (homepage, the Atelier page, cafés), not from a strategy document.

themes.asked: Four established machine brands are named first; Fréscopa appears in about 1 answer in 20.
themes.wanted: The Atelier launch: "the first Fréscopa machine with a feel for your mornings"
themes.experience: A compare page and a reviews page that state price, specs and trial terms as text

themes.asked: Small but growing. No machine brand is named on the largest topics.
themes.wanted: "Meet your coffee agent": the machine that learns your taste
themes.experience: One page per question: what a coffee agent is, how it learns, what it stores

themes.asked: Subscription services lead; roasters with a machine are rarely named.
themes.wanted: Beans reorder automatically; "a year of beans" bundle
themes.experience: A subscription page with prices, pause and cancel terms in the first screen

themes.asked: Questions about recyclability go unanswered by brands; retailers and forums are cited.
themes.wanted: "Kind by design": compostable pods, plastic-free refills
themes.experience: A sustainability page with the certification, the materials and how to dispose

themes.asked: Brand-specific care questions carry the theme. Fréscopa is named on its own, with thin sources.
themes.experience: Care guides per task (descale, milk system, filter) that owners and assistants can follow step by step

themes.asked: "Near me" questions carry the theme and chains are named. Classes and tours are open.
themes.wanted: "Come say hello": cafés as showrooms, tours and classes
themes.experience: A page per café and per class with address, hours and booking as text

themes.asked: Thin. Deals and financing questions name retailers, not machine brands.
themes.wanted: "Great coffee, without the barista price tag": students, monthly plan
themes.experience: An offers page: the bundle, the monthly price, the 30-night trial

themes.asked: Recipe sites and creators are named; machine brands rarely.
themes.experience: Journal guides that name the method and the source in the sentence
